More than one child can be specified using comma as a separator. Example: ?expand=Employees,Localizations. Nested children can also be provided following the format "Child.NestedChild" (Example: ?expand=Employees.Managers). If a nested child is provided (Example: Employees.Managers), the missing children will be processed implicitly. For example, "?expand=Employees.Managers" is the same as "?expand=Employees,Employees.Managers" (which will expand Employees and Managers).

This parameter filters the resource fields. Only the specified fields are returned, which means that if no fields are specified, no fields are returned (useful to get only the links).   • account; string; The combination of the values of the account segments assigned to the transaction.

  • accountedDebitAmount; number; The transaction debit amount in accounting currency.
  • accountingClass; string; The accounting class of the subledger transaction.
  • accountingClassCode; string; The short name classification of the journal entry lines.
  • accountingDate; string; The date used to determine the accounting period for the transaction.
  • applicationId; integer; The unique identifier of the functional area for subledger accounting.
  • assignmentRule; string; The name of the ownership definition assignment rule used to assign the ownership definition or direct billed stakeholder.
  • billWhenPaidFlag; boolean; Indicates whether to create joint venture distributions only for paid expenses or costs.
  • businessUnit; string; The name of the business unit associated with the joint venture.
  • carriedInterestAgreement; string; The name of the carried interest agreement associated with the joint venture transaction.
  • carriedInterestAgreementDescription; string; The description of the carried interest agreement associated with the joint venture transaction.
  • carriedInterestSourceOwnerDefinition; string; The name of the ownership definition used as the basis for creating the carried interest ownership definition assigned to the transaction.

  • currencyCode; string; The currency of the transaction amount.
  • distributionOnlyFlag; boolean; Indicates whether the transaction is for distribution only, not for invoicing.
  • enteredCreditAmount; number; The transaction credit amount in the entered currency.
  • enteredCurrencyCode; string; The currency code entered on the original transaction.
  • enteredDebitAmount; number; The transaction debit amount in the entered currency.
  • eventType; string; The event type of the subledger transaction.
  • expenditureBusinessUnit; string; The name of the expenditure business unit in Project Costing that's associated with the subledger accounting entry for the joint venture transaction.
  • expenditureItemDate; string; The date of the expenditure in Project Costing that's associated with the subledger accounting entry for the joint venture transaction.
  • expenditureOrganization; string; The name of the expenditure organization in Project Costing that's associated with the subledger accounting entry for the joint venture transaction.
  • expenditureType; string; The name identifying the expenditure classification.
  • expenditureTypeDescription; string; The description of the expenditure type.
  • headerId; integer; The unique identifier of the journal.
  • jointVentureDescription; string; The description of the joint venture.
  • jointVentureShortName; string; The unique name of the joint venture.
  • journalDescription; string; The description of the subledger accounting journal line.
  • lastUpdateDate; string; The date and time when the joint venture transaction was last updated.
  • lastUpdatedBy; string; The user who last updated the joint venture transaction.
  • ledgerName; string; The name of the ledger.
  • lineNumber; integer; The number of the journal line.

More than one child can be specified using comma as a separator. Example: ?expand=Employees,Localizations. If a nested child is provided (Example: Employees.Managers), the missing children will be processed implicitly. This parameter filters the resource fields. Only the specified fields are returned, which means that if no fields are specified, no fields are returned (useful to get only the links). If an indirect child resource is provided (Example: Employees.Managers), the missing children will be processed implicitly. This parameter filters the resource fields. Only the specified fields are returned, which means that if no fields are specified, no fields are returned (useful to get only the links). If an indirect child resource is provided (Example: Employees.Managers), the missing children will be processed implicitly.
